title: Unsupervised Detection of Contextualized Embedding Bias with Application to Ideology
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on detecting political ideology in contextualized embeddings. A subreddit named 'CatholicPolitics' is mentioned incidentally in a visualization (Figure 6), but no analysis is performed on it or on religious topics in general.
